text.markup: While Ruk'utan is face-down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn him face-up.{br}While Ruk'utan is face-up in arsenal, whenever you play a card with 6 or more {p}, **intimidate** and put a lesson counter on him. Then if there are 2 or more lesson counters on Ruk'utan, banish him, search your deck for Alpha Rampage, put it face-up in arsenal, and shuffle.
